reviews.text: I was looking for delicious Spanish food in Seoul and I finally found it! I had very high expectations, but Grados far exceeded them. We ordered beef tartare, croquettes, pork tenderloin pintxos, paella, and churros, and also received a cool sorbet as service. The beef tartare in particular was the best I've had in a long time, but all the food was really delicious. I definitely want to go again.

reviews.author: World Travelist
reviews.text:
Grados is a popular Spanish restaurant in Sangsu that recently moved to Garosu-gil.
Owner and chef Taeyong-won takes pride in his modern tapas and casual Spanish cuisine, and serves up flavorful dishes that live up to his reputation!
The price may seem a bit expensive, but it is well worth it.
The tapas are very appetizing and go perfectly with the signature beer, Tinto de Verano (15,000 won). Alhambra Lager is also very popular.
Roasted red peppers (10,000 won) are the perfect side dish to whet your appetite.
Among the main menus, we recommend Ragu Lasagna (25,000 won) and Octopus (33,000 won), but they may sell out early.
Be sure to try paella (39,000 won). It was so flavorful that I enjoyed it, even the slightly burnt part of the rice.
I enjoyed a really delicious and wonderful Spanish casual dining experience, and I would like to thank Chef Tae Yong-won.

The staff are also professional and friendly.

There is a spacious hall table and PDR for private dining.

reviews.text:
A speakeasy bar with a movie concept. Each season has a main movie theme, and popular cocktails from previous seasons can also be enjoyed at the curtain call. The current theme is .

♤ Dark Knight - from (25,000₩)
♤ Goblet of Fire - from (25,000₩)
♤ Ensemble - from (25,000₩)
♤ Cover charge (5,000₩)

Dark Night is a whiskey-based cocktail, similar to Godfather and Old Fashioned. It is a smoky and strong cocktail. The Goblet of Fire is inspired by the practice of writing names into a goblet during the Triwizard Tournament, and includes a performance where one writes one's wish and burns it. They give you coffee that has a strong cinnamon scent and can be enjoyed with it. Ensemble is a cocktail with a sour and bitter taste that feels like grapefruit punch.

There is a cover charge, but in addition to the basic snacks, they also provide snacks such as grilled bananas and mangoes, and the service is friendly, so it's worth it.

This place is full of concepts, so I recommend it to movie lovers.

#Chapter One

reviews.author: Jeongho Min
reviews.text:
My meal at Tielo in Gangnam Station was satisfactory from start to finish.

First of all, Fritura di Baccala was satisfying from the first bite as it had an excellent harmony between the soft cod meat inside and the crispy batter. It was especially great when paired with the arugula and mashed potatoes that were provided together.

The bottarga pasta I ordered next was attractive with the salty yet deep umami flavor of the fish roe, and the degree of doneness of the pasta made it stand out even more. However, it was disappointing that the sauce and noodles were not completely emulsified, so it felt like they were slightly separate.

The main dish, duck confit, was crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, with an impressive texture that seemed to melt in your mouth. The slightly sweet Demisec champagne served together enhanced the flavor of each dish and created a more harmonious experience.

The tofu gelato served as dessert was a refreshing ending to the meal, with its refreshing olive oil scent and soft texture. The overall high-quality menu and sophisticated atmosphere made it an excellent choice for a special day visit.

reviews.author: LoveIU
reviews.text:
If you are looking for an Italian restaurant with a nice atmosphere in Gangnam, I recommend Tiello.
Both pasta and dishes are carefully made with fresh ingredients and taste great.
The staff were friendly and the service was very satisfactory.
I am satisfied with the atmosphere, taste, and service, so I plan to visit again!

reviews.author: Jina Lee
reviews.text:
This is a place I enjoy going to whenever I meet up with my close friend in Gangnam, who really likes wine. The food is really delicious (especially the truffle cream gnocchi), and since it's been a while since I've been there, the new staff member (Kim Sun-ah) was very kind and good at explaining wines and recommending food pairings, so I was able to have a good time again for the first time in a long time.
Thank you, Sunah, and I look forward to seeing you again next time :)

reviews.author: Soo Lim
reviews.text: Four people ate oyster gratin, gnocchi, lamb rib steak, male tomato stew, and vongole pasta. The oyster gratin, gnocchi, and male tomato stew were really delicious, and the lamb rib steak was also really delicious~. The vongole soup was so delicious that I ate it with a spoon. I wasn't able to take all the pictures because I was eating. I liked the moderately casual atmosphere and the concentration of people chatting quietly. The food is luxurious for the price. A cost-effective fine dining restaurant! The recommended wine, Burgundy red wine, had a nice scent and was delicious. At the table next to me, two women who seemed to have come home from work were eating food with a bottle of wine, and it looked nice ^^

reviews.author: smiling man
reviews.text:
Visited on 22.10.28

Free corkage when ordering 3 menu items (over 45,000 won) for 2 people (up to 2 bottles)

A friend took me to a wine bar. The food is expensive, but it's okay for a wine bar, and considering that corkage is free, it doesn't seem that bad.

The owner has a lot of knowledge about wine, so you can sit at the counter and listen to various stories.
